description: One author's record in the calls ledger: calls, scored, open, hits, hit rate, average and median signed excess vs benchmark. author: 'me' (default) or an author id; an id without a label covers all its labels. Under 10 scored calls the result says it is noise. Suited to 'how good are my/their calls' questions. Free.
name: call_scorecard
title: Call scorecard
